source.author: verg
source.text: Allecto torvam faciem et furialia membra exuit, in vultus sese transformat anilis; et frontem obscenam rugis arat, induit albos cum vitta crinis, tum ramum innectit olivae; fit Calybe Iunonis anus templique sacerdos et iuveni ante oculos his se cum vocibus offert:
source.text_original: Allecto torvam faciem et furialia membra / exuit, in vultus sese transformat anilis; / et frontem obscenam rugis arat, induit albos / cum vitta crinis, tum ramum innectit olivae; / fit Calybe Iunonis anus templique sacerdos / et iuveni ante oculos his se cum vocibus offert: /
source.text_english: Allecto stripped off her grim face and her frenzied limbs, and transformed herself into the appearance of an old woman; she furrowed her shameless brow with wrinkles, put on white hair with a fillet, then wove in an olive branch; she became Calybe, an old priestess of Juno and priestess of the temple, and presented herself before the young man’s eyes with these words:

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: iam incanuit caput, tremunt genua, dentes cadunt et frontem obscenam rugis arat, uicina est mors in foribus, designatur rogus prope: uelimus nolimus, senes sumus.
reuse.text_original: iam incanuit caput, tremunt genua, dentes cadunt et frontem obscenam rugis arat, uicina est mors in foribus, designatur rogus prope: uelimus nolimus, senes sumus.
reuse.text_english: Now the head has grown gray, the knees tremble, the teeth fall out, and age furrows the shameless brow with wrinkles; death stands near at the threshold, the pyre is already marked out close by: whether we will or not, we are old.
